status: x-y-time-only lag-restricted self-history feasibility preflight frozen before vertical outcomes
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism discrimination; cannot alter v0.3.8
question: Does individual vertical organization persist when self-training information is restricted to sessions separated from the target by multiple days?

state_definition.thresholds: cohort medians of valid endpoint speed and absolute turn angle

session_time.definition: median timestamp of valid speed×turn endpoints within each frozen session
session_time.lag: absolute difference between target-session and training-session median timestamps

feasibility.self_history: same-individual sessions in the same frozen cohort whose median timestamp differs from the target by at least the candidate lag
feasibility.other_history: all retained sessions of other individuals in the same cohort
feasibility.target_support: target speed×turn endpoint whose 5-km cell×state stratum occurs in at least one lag-qualified self session and in at least one other-individual session
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one target session with >=50 supported endpoints
feasibility.selection_rule: Choose the first (largest-lag) candidate for which every panel retains at least 70% of the frozen speed×turn baseline n and at least 5 individuals. If none passes, stop the five-panel persistence family before vertical outcome.

planned_test_if_feasible.stable_individual_hypothesis: Individual centered vertical organization persists across multi-day separation and is not only a short-lived state.
planned_test_if_feasible.transient_context_hypothesis: Identity weakens to its exchangeability null when only temporally distant self sessions are available.
planned_test_if_feasible.estimator: P(centered residual height | 5-km cell, speed×turn state) from lag-qualified same-individual sessions versus equal-individual other profiles on identical common support
planned_test_if_feasible.calibration: whole-session label permutation within frozen cohort; session timestamps and x-y-time-state-z blocks remain attached to session; lag qualification is rebuilt under each permuted identity assignment
planned_test_if_feasible.panel_pass_rule: exact observed preflight n; calibrated identity >0; one-sided p(null>=observed)<=0.05
planned_test_if_feasible.synthesis: 4 or 5 PASS => multi-day stable individual organization; 2 or 3 => context-dependent persistence; 0 or 1 => short-lived context/state becomes a leading explanation.

claim_boundary: Multi-day persistence does not prove genetic or intrinsic personality effects.
The test distinguishes temporal stability from short-lived context only at the selected lag scale.
No inference applies beyond tracking durations represented in the public data.
This extension remains outside frozen v0.3.8.
stop_rule: Do not change lag sequence 7/3/1 days, session-time definition, speed2_turn2 state, 5-km grid, 70% retention, >=5 floor or 50-event support after preflight output.
Do not inspect vertical outcomes while selecting lag.
If no lag passes all five panels, stop the five-panel family rather than inventing a shorter threshold.
